author: newark reporter
title: Devils and Rangers set for first Madison Square Garden meeting of the season
text:
The New Jersey Devils will face the New York Rangers at Madison Square Garden on March 18 for their first matchup at the venue this season. The game is scheduled to begin at 7 p.m. Eastern Time.
This contest marks an important moment in the rivalry between the two teams, known as the Hudson River Rivalry. Both teams are looking to build momentum as they approach the final stretch of the regular season.
The Devils have recently found success, winning six of their last eight games with a strong offensive showing, averaging nearly four goals per game during that span. They completed a seven-game homestand with a record of five wins and two losses, including victories over Toronto, Los Angeles, Boston, and the Rangers. The team now begins a five-game road trip starting with this matchup against New York.
Meanwhile, the Rangers have struggled throughout much of the season and currently hold the worst record in the Eastern Conference. However, they have shown improvement lately by winning five out of their last seven games, including wins over Minnesota, Philadelphia, and Toronto. The upcoming schedule favors them with 11 out of their next 13 games being played at home.
Key players to watch include Jack Hughes for New Jersey, who recently reached his 400th career NHL point faster than any player in franchise history and has tallied ten points in his last five games. For New York, Alexis Lafreniere had a productive stretch before going scoreless in his last two outings but still has accumulated fifteen points in his past twelve contests.
Injuries may play a role as several players from both teams are sidelined due to various ailments. The Devils previously defeated the Rangers 6-3 earlier this month in New Jersey.
